verdict.rationale: Netlify offers serverless functions, so the question of documented execution limits applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack states any CPU time, wall-clock timeout, or duration limit for functions, so long-running or agentic workloads cannot be assessed.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
